title: The V1 code exchange reads grant_type, code and redirect_uri from the query string and answers the five documented members

source.note: The overview: the authorization URL takes response_type=code, client_id, scope and redirect_uri, and redirects with code and state; the exchange 'values must be passed as query parameters' with HTTP Basic client_id:client_secret; both sample responses carry access_token, token_type bearer, refresh_token, expires_in 3599 and scope 'financial-api orders-api ' -- the trailing space is in both documented samples; that it is always present is this unit's judgment. The authorize route is a stand-in for the consent screen, and the code below is the first one a fresh unit mints (deterministic by C06/C22).

steps.name: exchange the code through the query string
